[[File:RryattTrailShadowlands-SWG.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shadowlands of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], seen at the end of the [[Rryatt Trail]]]]
The '''Shadowlands''', also known as the '''Shadow Forest''' and the '''Nother World''', was the dark ground level of the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was dark since the [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] could not reach it through the tall trees and the rich foliage.

==History==
The Shadowlands were a dangerous place, inhabited by savage beasts like [[Katarn/Legends|katarns]] and [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]]. [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] seldom went there (by means of wooden elevators) from their platforms. They visited only for ceremonial reasons, such as [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|rites of passage]]. Famous Wookiees like [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] would often go there to prove themselves against the forest's strong, natural obstacles. It was also a place of exile.

[[File:Shadowlands-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|250px|left|A ritual site within the Shadowlands]]
The creation of the Shadowlands may have been due in part to a malfunctioning [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] machine created by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. According to a holo-adapted interface installed by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to better access the ancient data, the planet was incapable of sustaining sufficient levels of production and had to be terraformed in order to export produce. According to [[Jolee Bindo]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energies of the [[Star Map]] and the malfunctioning machine may have led to the accelerated evolution of various species, leaving the Shadowlands extremely dangerous when the Rakata abandoned Kashyyyk.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

When Revan visited the Shadowlands to find the Star Map for a second time, he found Jolee living in a hut in the depths of the forest. In order for Revan to find the Star Map, he was asked by Jolee to deal with [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] employees that were [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Tach/Legends|tach]] glands for use in [[Tarisian ale]]. The hunters were displaced when Revan managed to deactivate the sonic field, which they had set up to prevent large predatory animals of the Shadowlands from attacking them. The deactivation resulted in a terentatek rampaging through the camp. Jolee then agreed to shut off a [[Force field/Legends|force field]] that the Czerka crews had set up, allowing Revan to access the ancient Star Map.<ref name="KOTOR" />

In [[3638 BBY]], new burial sites were discovered in the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk that gave new information regarding the ancient history of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Beneath the Wroshyr Trees}}</ref>

Around [[155 BBY]], [[Tojjevvuk]] fell in the Shadowlands and was killed by the creatures below.

At some point in time before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a large group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]], was abandoned in the Shadowlands below the [[Rryatt Trail]]. Later, a group of dark-adapted [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] hunters and poachers also discovered the dark jungle, built a [[Gotal hunter camp|hunting camp]] and began exploiting the fierce wildlife.
